title: Vampire Vape Desserts Pistachio Milkshake E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Pistachio Milkshake by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range offers a luxurious blend of roasted Pistachio flavour stirred through a smooth, velvety Milkshake base. This indulgent vape captures the nutty richness of Pistachio, mellowed by the cool creaminess of a classic milkshake drink, for an expertly layered and comforting flavour experience. Blended at 70% VG to 30% PG, this high-VG shortfill is designed for sub-ohm vaping, delivering thick vapour and a deeper, more rounded flavour. Each bottle contains 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, leaving room for a 10ml nicotine shot if desired. Made in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, Pistachio Milkshake is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts range — a collection of rich, dessert-style e-liquids designed for vapers who enjoy familiar sweet yet complex flavour profiles. Also available in Freebase 10mls and Concentrates.
